# Repository metadata

Values to keep in sync with the GitHub repository settings
(Settings → General, and the About panel on the repo home page).
These cannot be set via the API without maintainer credentials, so they are
tracked here and applied manually — see the manual checklist in
`docs/promotion/` (or the visibility plan this file was generated from) for
the full list of one-time settings.

## Description (max 350 chars, keep it under 120 for search result readability)

full projects and production-tuned demo instances.
